description: Full auto: nothing is asked, nothing is sandboxed, and the two capability keys this build actually names are on. `approval_policy` is never, `sandbox_mode` is danger-full-access, `web_search` is live -- the most capable of the four modes -- and the local-image tool is enabled. The vendor's reference also documents feature flags for hooks, memories and multi-agent; this build carries none of those spellings, so setting them would write keys it ignores. They are left out until a build names them. This is a setup posture -- keys in this product's own configuration file. It is not an execution profile and it grants no environment: what it changes is what the product asks you and which of its own tools exist, not what anyone is permitted to run.
